xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:ExplanationForTheDeviationOrVa: As per the Notice to Shareholders dated September 04, 2024, NSE/CML/2022/56 dated December 13, 2022, and the BSE Circular No. 20221213-47 dated December 13, 2022, the Company may adjust the amount specified for the issue size by up to 10% based on future circumstances. Accordingly, during the quarter ended September 30, 2026, the Company has allocated an amount of Rs. 3.00 crore towards object 1 (Debt Repayment), Object 3 (Legal payment to Singapore parties) and Object 5 (GCP) (financial assistance) and same has been adjusted with object 4 (Financial assistance). Hence, the cost has been revised within permissible limits, which is less than 10%. The revised allocation is approved/ratified in the board meeting dated on May 30, 2026.
